rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural change: each recurrent tail block now learns a small staged refresh of the shared decoder-output anchor toward the carried recurrent state. This keeps the proven reverse-tail carry path, adds only a tiny control tensor budget, stays quantization-friendly by treating the new gates like other control tensors, and tests a nearby anchor-mix variant that matches the strongest remaining local signal better than another scalar hyperparameter sweep.
title: Staged Tail Anchor Refresh Gate
